images.title: Setup: clients, layout and monitors
images.alt: WoWBoxer, Setup: three WoW windows in the Main + side layout on one monitor – the main window big on the left, two followers stacked on the right – and the squad list with every window connected.
images.caption: Pick how many clients and a layout – every window goes to its place as it opens.

images.title: Two monitors, Free for all
images.alt: WoWBoxer Setup with two monitors (2560×1440 and 1920×1080) and the Free for all layout: four WoW windows arranged by hand over both monitors on the map – window 2 straddles the border between them.
images.caption: Two monitors, Free for all: drag any window anywhere – across monitors too.

images.title: Ten clients in two parties
images.alt: WoWBoxer Setup with ten WoW clients in two parties of five over two monitors; the squad list is grouped into Party 1 and Party 2.
images.caption: Up to 10 clients: two parties of five, each with its own main.

images.title: Window details
images.alt: WoWBoxer Setup with the details of window 1 open: name, class, position and size in pixels, always on top, and whether the whole action bar fits.
images.caption: Fine-tune any window: exact position and size, on top, and an action-bar check.

images.title: Settings: hover to activate and action bar
images.alt: WoWBoxer Settings: hover to activate windows (a Windows setting) with its delay, the action-bar fit (UI Scale) and the window rules.
images.caption: Hover to activate is a Windows setting – it sends nothing to the game. Auto-fit keeps the whole action bar in view.

images.title: Help and Report a problem
images.alt: WoWBoxer Help tab: the Report a problem button, links to the WoWBoxer Discord, YouTube and website, tools to see what the app sees, and common problems with their fixes.
images.caption: Stuck? Common problems with their fixes, and Report a problem for #setup-help on Discord.

images.title: About and community links
images.alt: WoWBoxer About tab: version, MIT licence, privacy (no telemetry) and the Discord, YouTube and website links.
images.caption: Free and open source (MIT). No telemetry – your layouts and logs stay on your PC.

images.title: Tray menu
images.alt: The WoWBoxer tray menu: Open WoWBoxer, Open missing WoW clients, Re-arrange, Identify windows, Stop placing windows, Hover to activate windows, Report a problem and Quit.
images.caption: Everything you need mid-raid is one right-click away in the tray.

images.title: Welcome screen
images.alt: WoWBoxer welcome screen on first start: what the app does (places WoW windows) and what it never does (no keys or clicks sent to the game, no memory reading, no injection).
images.caption: What it does – and what it never does.
